```{r}
#| message: false
here::i_am("Projet-data-chatgpt.Rproj")
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(vroom)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r}
#| message: false

survey_data <- vroom(here("data", "survey dataset.csv"), 
                     delim = ";", 
                     locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"))
wb_data <- vroom(here("data", "World Bank Country and Lending Groups .csv"))

```

```{r}
#| message: false

survey_summary <- data.frame(
  Fichier = "survey dataset.csv",
  Lignes = nrow(survey_data),
  Colonnes = ncol(survey_data),
  Variables_numeriques = survey_data |> select(where(is.numeric)) |> ncol(),
  Variables_caracteres = survey_data |> select(where(is.character)) |> ncol(),
  Valeurs_manquantes = sum(is.na(survey_data))
)

wb_summary <- data.frame(
  Fichier = "World Bank Country and Lending Groups .csv",
  Lignes = nrow(wb_data),
  Colonnes = ncol(wb_data),
  Variables_numeriques = wb_data |> select(where(is.numeric)) |> ncol(),
  Variables_caracteres = wb_data |> select(where(is.character)) |> ncol(),
  Valeurs_manquantes = sum(is.na(wb_data))
)

survey_summary
wb_summary
```
